thesis: The host explains that his podcast began as an unstructured side project with no specific goals, evolving from recording conversations with friends in the institutional investing world to becoming a sponsored show. He notes that his interviewing style has improved significantly over time by learning to listen more rather than talk excessively, a habit he had to consciously develop as an extrovert.
